optimizedDescription.value: Defines instruction, shell, and external hooks, binding-driven execution, skip controls, ordering, templating, and resilient failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# Hook Execution Model

## Rules
- Hook entry: `id` plus exactly one `instruction:`, `run:`, or `external: { type, config }`; otherwise `SchemaValidationError`. Every workflow step supports all forms.
- `instruction:`: passive query-time text consumed only by `GetHookInstructions(step, phase, hookId?)`; never process, side effect, predicate/effect, runtime execution, or `CompileContext` content.
- `run:`: shell command executed by `HookRunner`; returns exit code/stdout/stderr; never agent context. `external:`: dispatched only to registered runner accepting `external.type`; missing runner fails clearly.
- `TransitionChange`/`ArchiveChange` auto-execute matching executable effects after predicates. Binding supplies `phase`/`onFailure`; use cases never branch or launch by check id. Registered hook effects delegate collection, recording, execution to `RunStepHooks`.
- Transition effects match `from`/`to`/`along`; executable `hook.pre` and forward-only source `hook.post` run `before-persist`, default abort. Archive `hook.pre` runs abort/`before-persist`; `hook.post` collect/`after-persist`.
- Manual selectors: transition `source.pre|source.post|target.pre|target.post|all`; archive `pre|post|all`. `--skip-hooks` skips matching effects only; predicates remain. Manual skill flow must preserve `along` filter.
- Executable hook `onFailure: abort|warn` (default abort). `abort` nonzero halts and yields `success:false`; `warn` captures real exit/stdout/stderr in `warnings`, emits telemetry, continues. Phase succeeds when all failures are warnings.
- Post mutation failures never roll back committed state; abort still halts remaining post hooks, warn continues.
- Ordering per phase: schema hooks declaration order, then project `schemaOverrides` declaration order.
- `HookRunner` expands `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.path}}`, `{{project.root}}`; unknown paths unchanged; `{{change.workspace}}` unsupported. Substitute verbatim; author owns quoting; runner translates only host-unsupported quote syntax; callers never shell-escape/add quoting.

## Constraints
- `Change` entity never executes hooks; application layer owns execution.
- `instruction:` never executes or enters predicates/effects; `run:` never enters agent context.
- `RunStepHooks` is single engine for hook checks, lifecycle use cases, CLI.
- Pre hooks fail fast for abort policy; transition source.post is forward-only abort/before-persist; archive post uses collect/after-persist.
- `--skip-hooks` affects effects only.
